QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_20

question.text: The IMA of Chambal Managed Futures Fund proposes to increase the performance-fee rate above the hurdle. Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, this constitutes a 'material change' to the PPM and triggers:

answer.text: A requirement to dissolve the scheme within 30 days.
Automatic approval by SEBI without any investor action.
A compulsory exit option to existing investors.
Mandatory conversion of the scheme into a Large Value Fund.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5.3 states: 'The SEBI (AIF) Regulations also provide for a compulsory exit option in case the change to the PPM is a case of a material change.' Material changes include change in sponsor/manager, change in control of sponsor/manager, and change in FEE STRUCTURE/HURDLE that may adversely affect investors. The Trap: Option A fabricates dissolution. Option B wrongly removes investor agency. Option D has no legal basis. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the material-change list and exit-option consequence. XIX-B (Cat III Distributor) must proactively inform clients of exit-option events. Chapter 13 discusses implementation details.
